# Sirach Chapter 47 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 47 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_047_page_001.jpg

---

**47:1** And after him Nathan rose up to prophesy in the days of David.

**47:2** As the fat is separated from the peace offering, so David was separated from the children of Israel.

**47:3** He played with lions as with young goats, and with bears as with lambs of the flock.

**47:4** In his youth, did he not kill a giant, and remove reproach from the people, when he lifted his hand with a smooth stone and struck down the boasting of Goliath?

**47:5** For he called upon the Most High Lord, and he gave strength to his right arm to strike down a mighty warrior and lift up the horn of his people.

**47:6** Therefore the daughters of Israel mourned for him and praised him for his tens of thousands.

**47:7** When he put on the armor and took up weapons of war, he drew the sword against the Philistines, and his hand made sport of many.

**47:8** Before taking his part, he would set his hands right. In all his deeds he gave thanks to the Holy One, the Most High, with words of glory.

**47:9** With his whole heart he sang praises and loved the one who made him. He set singers before the altar, and from their sound he made sweet melody.

**47:10** He gave beauty to the feast days and arranged the appointed times to completion, throughout the year, while they praised his holy name, and the sanctuary rang from early morning.

**47:11** The Lord took away his sins and exalted his horn forever; he gave him a covenant of kings and a throne of glory in Israel.

**47:12** After him rose a wise son who because of him lived in a wide place.

**47:13** Solomon reigned in days of peace, and God gave him rest on every side, so that he might build a house in his name and prepare a sanctuary forever.

**47:14** How wise you were in your youth, and you were filled with understanding like a river!

**47:15** Your soul covered the earth, and you filled it with dark parables.

**47:16** Your name reached to far-off islands, and you were loved for your peace.

**47:17** For your songs and proverbs and parables and interpretations, the lands marveled at you.

**47:18** By the name of the Lord God, who is called the God of Israel, you gathered gold like tin and amassed silver like lead.

**47:19** But you put your loins beside women, and by your body you were brought into subjection.

**47:20** You put a stain on your glory and profaned your offspring, bringing wrath upon your children — and they were grieved over your folly,

**47:21** because the kingdom was divided, and out of Ephraim a disobedient kingdom arose.

**47:22** But the Lord will not abandon his mercy, and he will not let any of his works fall; he will not blot out the posterity of his chosen one, and he will not destroy the offspring of him who loved him; so he gave a remnant to Jacob and to David a root from himself.

**47:23** Solomon rested with his ancestors, and left behind him of his seed — Rehoboam, broad in folly and lacking in sense, who turned the people away by his counsel. Then Jeroboam son of Nebat made Israel sin and showed Ephraim a sinful path.

**47:24** Their sins were exceedingly great, so that they drove them from their land.

**47:25** For they sought out every kind of wickedness, until vengeance came upon them.
